query: What drives customer satisfaction (Overall Rating) across the different airlines?

per_column.name: crew_attitude
per_column.rationale: Extracted qualitative crew attitude from review text. It is a distinct behavioral driver that lies outside the rating and plausibly influences satisfaction without restating or leaking the outcome.

per_column.name: crew_proactivity
per_column.rationale: Whether crew were proactive/reactive/absent is an observable service behavior distinct from the overall rating and carries genuine predictive signal.

per_column.name: service_consistency
per_column.rationale: Consistency of service is a service-quality attribute separate from the rating; plausibly predictive. Some correlation with existing service columns, but not a deterministic restatement of the focus.

per_column.name: operational_disruption_type
per_column.rationale: Type of operational disruption (delay, cancellation, etc.) is an objective event outside the rating and a strong plausible driver of satisfaction. Not leakage.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: How disruptions were handled is a distinct service dimension that plausibly predicts satisfaction and is not a component or restatement of the rating.

per_column.name: post_flight_resolution_quality
per_column.rationale: Quality of post-flight issue resolution is a separate operational/service variable that plausibly drives the rating without being a deterministic function of it.

per_column.name: special_needs_accommodation
per_column.rationale: Whether special needs were accommodated is an outside factor that could influence satisfaction. Weak due to heavy class imbalance (37 true), but still a legitimate predictor.

judge.rationale: All seven added columns are legitimate predictors derived from the review text that lie outside the overall_rating and are not restatements, components, or leakage. They introduce genuinely new dimensions (crew behavior, service consistency, operational disruptions and their handling, post-flight resolution, special-needs accommodation) that the original structured ratings do not fully capture, giving a model meaningful additional leverage. Utility is strong but not maximal: several features partly overlap with existing Staff Service / service ratings, and special_needs_accommodation is severely imbalanced, limiting incremental signal.
